name: Escape From The Island
detailed_description:
Your fifth anniversary together is approaching, and you want to surprise your girlfriend with a truly special gift. Since it's summer, and you've recently come into possession of a few valuable items, you come up with a brilliant idea: a luxurious week-long cruise from the USA to Spain, followed by another week exploring the sunny cities of the country. A perfect plan!

She seems surprised that you can afford such a trip, but after reassuring her that the money isn't from any illegal source or borrowed, she agrees. The journey begins. Everything is going smoothly, until an unforeseen storm appears on the planned route. Not wanting to interrupt the voyage, the captain decides to sail around it. Suddenly, an island emerges on the horizon. Nothing unusual, except it doesn't appear on the GPS.

The next thing you remember is a loud crash… and then waking up on a beach, soaked and barely alive. Stranded, alone, and with no way back—will you survive the mysteries of the island? The adventure begins now!

Planned game features:

  • A harsh, deserted island full of secrets waiting to be uncovered

  • A hunger system that forces players to carefully plan ahead

  • Vast caves and dense jungles that become increasingly dangerous the deeper you go

  • A realistic crafting system

  • An original soundtrack composed exclusively for the game

This game is a sequel to "Escape From The Valley", but no prior knowledge of that game is required to enjoy this one. The story takes place several years later and explains some of the events from the first part.

short_description: Escape From The Island is a 2D, pixel-art survival game in which, as a castaway on a dangerous, uninhabited island, you collect supplies, build a shelter and fight for survival while discovering the secrets of this island.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly on most modern machines. If it works on a toaster, please let us know.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU like GTX 660 / Radeon HD 7850 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo sound support
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly on most modern machines. If it works on a toaster, please let us know.
